mapper.select: SELECT activity.activity_date, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT activity.student_id) AS BIGINT) AS active_students FROM ( SELECT CAST(e.occurred_at AS DATE) AS activity_date, a.student_id FROM learn_task_assignment_event e JOIN learn_task_assignment a ON a.id = e.assignment_id JOIN edu_student_organization so ON so.student_id = a.student_id AND so.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND so.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_organization org ON org.id = so.organization_id AND org.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND org.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE e.event_type IN ('CLAIMED','CHECKED_IN','PAUSED','RESUMED','ABANDONED') AND UNION ALL SELECT CAST(s.supplemented_at AS DATE) AS activity_date, r.student_id FROM growth_review_supplement s JOIN growth_review r ON r.id = s.review_id JOIN edu_student_organization so ON so.student_id = r.student_id AND so.relation_type = 'CLASS' AND so.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sys_organization org ON org.id = so.organization_id AND org.organization_type = 'CLASS' AND org.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE ) activity WHERE activity.activity_date >= #{start} AND activity.activity_date <= #{end} GROUP BY activity.activity_date ORDER BY activity.activity_date
